texts.story: Policy 23 (P23) emerges as the top driving policy in the system, with the highest weighted outgoing coherence score of +31.00 and its strongest influence through the reinforcing relationship Policy 23 (P23) -> Policy 13 (P13) (+3.00 Reinforcing), which indicates a not yet fully stable and structurally significant interaction. In contrast, the linkage Urban Mobility Plan (P1) -> Renewable Energy Act (P2) remains contested across decision-makers, reflecting a lack of consensus and highlighting an area of uncertainty within the system.
